cause: InputType::create() gates each type behind a runtime setting (Settings::inputTypeDateEnabled, inputTypeColorEnabled, ...); a rejected type silently stays text
effect_on_hunt: every chooser-based reentrancy surface is gone: no date/time picker, no colour picker
range survives, but RangeInputType::handleKeydownEvent wraps its dispatch in EventQueueScope and HTMLInputElement::stepUp passes DispatchNoEvent, so that path is guarded
TextFieldInputType::setValue (text/number/search/email/url/tel) holds Ref<HTMLInputElement> input(*element()) explicitly to survive a handler that changes the input type - hardened
remaining form-control surface: FileInputType (native dialog) only
